use: Style evidence only; never copy phrases, facts, numbers or identity.
method: Roster weights normalized over available eligible donors; equal mass per donor post; sentence mass equal within post. UTC cadence over observed scrape interval. Signature lift is weighted cluster document frequency divided by unweighted eligible all-donor document frequency (3-word EN / 4-character ZH n-grams, present in at least 2 cluster posts).

qualitative.variation_notes: Length ranges from single-clause reactions to multi-paragraph mechanism explainers and report teasers; median sentence length is about nine words, with the interquartile range at about 6–15. Register moves between neutral research-desk language, casual lowercase personal notes and pointed political or cultural irony. Most posts open with a claim, while data-led, contrast, title-header and reaction openings appear less often. Emoji are uncommon and mostly appear as pointers or report labels.
qualitative.judgment_style: Views are mostly stated assertively, sometimes reduced to a single cause, and data is used as backing rather than as the whole message. Research-style posts hedge more, with conditional phrasing about ranges, catalysts and risk; speculative inferences are flagged as possible and supported with explicit reasons. Opinion pieces lean on analogy and historical cycles rather than formal qualifiers.
